question: According to the passage what is the location of the start of earthquake directly above it on the surface of the earth is called?
solution:
The correct answer is "​**epicenter.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• We are required to name the location where the earthquake hits the center of the earth.
 
• Refer to the following lines from the passage:
 
 
• Line 1 and 2: 
 
 
• The location below the earth’s surface where the earthquake starts is called the hypocenter,
 
• and **the location directly above it on the surface of the earth is called the epicenter.**
 
 
 
 
 
• **​**​From the highlighted part in the above given lines, it is clear that name of the location where the earthquake hits the center is called "epicenter."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.
